# Risk Template — GULA Platform

## Risk: R-NNN: [Risk Title]

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Risk** | Description of the risk |
| **Category** | Security / Architecture / Testing / Deployment / Compliance / Operational |
| **Likelihood** | 1 (Very Low) — 5 (Very High) |
| **Impact** | 1 (Very Low) — 5 (Catastrophic) |
| **Score** | Likelihood × Impact |
| **Score Level** | 1-3 Low / 4-6 Medium / 7-9 High / 10+ Critical |
| **Current Mitigation** | What is currently in place |
| **Residual Risk** | Score after mitigations |
| **Status** | Managed / Mitigating / Unmanaged / Monitoring |
| **Owner** | Person responsible |
| **Review Date** | When risk should be reassessed |

Detailed description of the risk scenario, including how it could manifest, what systems are affected, and potential consequences.
